notablePrerequisites: At least one +1/+1 counter on Phyrexian Marauder.
description:
Sacrifice Phyrexian Marauder to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Ugin's Conjurant from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Ugin's Conjurant for {1}.
Sacrifice Ugin's Conjurant to Ashnod's Altar for {C}{C}.
Colfenor triggers, returning Phyrexian Marauder from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Phyrexian Marauder for {1}.
Repeat.
